dishes.name: Sambal Kangkung
dishes.benefit: Dark leafy greens full of iron, fried fast in hot sambal.
dishes.line: Whole plate finished before the rice even reached the table.

dishes.name: Bayam Soup
dishes.benefit: Sweet soft leaves, one slice of ginger, clear and light.
dishes.line: One pot on the stove, everybody drinks two bowls.

dishes.name: Chap Chye
dishes.benefit: Whatever greens are around, stewed soft with tanghoon, plenty of fibre.
dishes.line: Cooked big, eaten for days, somehow better on day two.

dishes.name: Nasi Lemak
dishes.benefit: Rice cooked with a knotted pandan leaf, sambal on the side.
dishes.line: Pandan rice steaming at six in the morning, kitchen light on.

dishes.name: Mee Goreng
dishes.benefit: Noodles, greens and egg in one pan, calamansi squeezed over.
dishes.line: Squeeze the calamansi first, then eat, always that order.

dishes.name: Sambal Sweet Potato Leaves
dishes.benefit: Tender leaves with garlic and belacan, ready before the rice is.
dishes.line: Grown along the fence, picked young, on the table by six.
